sprint: Two New Text Font Styles -- Marker Handwriting + Shape-Mosaic Fill
task: User sent two reference images (hand-drawn marker/sketch lettering + a name spelled with each letter filled by colourful geometric shapes) and asked what these styles are called, then made the governing request: 'i want these fonts available in builder as well studio. alphabets, numbers should also be part of shapes.' Deliverable 1: 'Permanent Marker' (Google Fonts, OFL) added as a real Font Family option across every font-choice list in the app (Theme Designer, both Text quick-edit popups, Sticker Studio's Text panel). Deliverable 2: a genuine, dynamic Shape-Mosaic Fill Style for text -- never a static reproduction of one name -- working for the full A-Z alphabet and 0-9 digits, any typed content, any font. Implemented via a canvas glyph-as-clip-mask + source-in composite technique in renderer/slideRenderer.js's new _drawShapeMosaicTextBlock, using a deterministic (never Math.random) 6-colour palette so the same text always renders the same pixels. A tri-state Story-Author-override-wins-over-Theme-Author-base precedence matches every other typography field already shipped. A Fill Style (Solid/Shapes) toggle is now reachable on every relevant authoring surface, mirrored by hand into World Builder v2's engineRuntime.js for Publish Fidelity. Verified via verify_font_shapefill.js (37/0) plus every existing rotation/text-fidelity suite passing unchanged; both goldenBuild.js suites pass unchanged.
